up: Retrieve IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human estrogen receptor. Output columns must be: compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), compound key (compound_records.compound_key), PubMed ID or DOI (from docs, prefer pubmed_id over doi), assay description (assays.description), target name (target_dictionary.pref_name), and organism (target_dictionary.organism). Filter on standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Filter target to human estrogen receptor (Homo sapiens). Do not apply row limits or ranking.
sql:
SELECT
    md.chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    a.description AS assay_description,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism,
    act.standard_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON act.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND td.pref_name LIKE '%estrogen receptor%'
